macros.name: ClockFramefalse
macros.doc: Saying \ClockFramefalse lets the border disappear, saying \ClockFrametrue lets the border appear.

macros.name: texttime
macros.doc: \texttime shows the system time at the time of compilation in a colon-separated 24 hour format.
